## Non-functional requirements

| NFR                                              | Quality characteristic | Measure                                                                                                                                        | Priority | Verify           | Tests  |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------- | ------ |
| [NFR-PROJECT-01](../requirements/project/nfr.md) | Security               | Every project endpoint returns the same 404 status, `code` and `detail` for an unknown key and for a project the caller is not in (OWASP API1) | Must     | Auto-API         | ⚠ none |
| [NFR-PROJECT-02](../requirements/project/nfr.md) | Security               | One permission map; a unit test covers both access levels × every action in the matrix; every write endpoint calls the check (OWASP API5)      | Must     | Unit, Review     | —      |
| [NFR-PROJECT-03](../requirements/project/nfr.md) | Reliability            | Both written in one database transaction; a forced failure after the change leaves neither                                                     | Must     | Unit, Auto-API   | ⚠ none |
| [NFR-PROJECT-04](../requirements/project/nfr.md) | Security               | `key`, `id`, `createdById`, `status` (on create) and unknown fields in a body are rejected with 400 (OWASP API3, mass assignment)              | Must     | Auto-API         | ⚠ none |
| [NFR-PROJECT-05](../requirements/project/nfr.md) | Security               | Activity pages hold at most 100 entries (default 20); `search` is at most 100 characters (OWASP API4)                                          | Should   | Auto-API         | ⚠ none |
| [NFR-PROJECT-06](../requirements/project/nfr.md) | Performance efficiency | With 200 projects and 10 000 activity entries, 95% of list, detail and activity requests answer in under 500 ms on a developer laptop          | Should   | Manual           | —      |
| [NFR-PROJECT-07](../requirements/project/nfr.md) | Interaction capability | WCAG 2.2 level AA on SCR-PROJECT-01 to SCR-PROJECT-05; no axe violations; every dialog traps and returns focus                                 | Should   | Manual           | —      |
| [NFR-PROJECT-08](../requirements/project/nfr.md) | Maintainability        | Every error response is `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) and matches the `problemSchema` in `openapi.yaml`                                | Must     | Auto-API, Review | ⚠ none |
